module_summary: Linear five-state FSM that after reset steps B0..B3 asserting shift_ena for four cycles, then parks in Done.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Sequencing state register B0-B3-Done acting as a 4-cycle timer

anchors.name: shift_ena
anchors.why: Shift register enable decoded from states B0 through B3

groups.name: shift_enable_fsm
groups.description: Enables external shift register for exactly four cycles after reset
